2225-2239-7507-8043.easyPrerequisites: You haven't cast a spell for free using Vision this turn.
2225-2239-7507-8043.description:
Cast Kindred Charge for free due to Vision, choosing a creature type granted by Hivestone, creating a token copy of each creature you control with haste, and setting up a delayed exile trigger.
Put the copy of Vision whose ability has been used in your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When the Ardent Elementalist token enters, it triggers, returning Kindred Charge from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: as a copy of Myth Unbound

708-2210-2459-4247.description:
Activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing Rograkh.
Choose to have Rograkh return to the command zone from your graveyard.
Myth Unbound and Mirrormade trigger, causing you to draw two cards.
Resolve the Bloodthrone Vampire ability.
Cast Rograkh from the command zone by paying {0} due to the cost reductions from Myth Unbound and Mirrormade.
Repeat.

222-527-3899-4742.easyPrerequisites:
You control a Saproling.
You control a creature with power 5 or greater.
222-527-3899-4742.description:
Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {1}{B}{R}{G}{G}.
Activate Spawning Pit twice by sacrificing Selvala and Slimefoot and Squee.
Activate Slimefoot and Squee by paying {1}{B}{R}{G} and sacrificing a Saproling, returning it and Selvala from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Slimefoot and Squee enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Repeat.

1170-2981-5131-7052--202.easyPrerequisites: You haven't cast an artifact spell using Muldrotha this turn.
1170-2981-5131-7052--202.description:
Cast the artifact from your graveyard using Muldrotha's ability by paying {0} due to Savvy Trader.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Muldrotha, allowing you to use its ability again this turn.
Resolve the artifact spell.
Activate Megatog by sacrificing the artifact, giving Megatog +3/+3 until end of turn
Repeat.

851-4682-7890.notablePrerequisites: At least two opponents cannot pay for Smothering Tithe's trigger.
851-4682-7890.description:
Activate Gleaming Splendor by paying {2}{W}, causing two opponents to each draw a card.
Smothering Tithe triggers twice, creating four Treasure tokens due to Adrix and Nev
Activate three Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {2}{W}.
Repeat any number of times.
Once you have near-infinite Treasure tokens, you may repeat the loop targeting yourself as one of the players in step 1, drawing any number of cards.

3375-4399-4518-4716.description:
Cast Kor Skyfisher by paying {0} and 2 life due to Defiler of Faith and The Immortal Sun.
Defiler of Faith triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Prosperous Innkeeper triggers, causing you to gain life.
Resolve Kor Skyfisher. When it enters, it and Prosperous Innkeeper trigger.
Resolve the Kor Skyfisher trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Prosperous Innkeeper trigger, causing you to gain life.
Repeat.
3375-4399-4518-4716.notes: If your life total is below 3 to start, instead pay {W} when casting Kor Skyfisher for the first time.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to any other creature you control

676-3259-4478.notablePrerequisites: At least one opponent cannot block creatures you control.
676-3259-4478.description:
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached and Magnus the Red, triggering Breath of Fury and Magnus the Red.
Resolve the Magnus the Red trigger, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Breath of Fury trigger, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to a creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one. 
Repeat each combat phase.

uses.battlefieldCardState: as a copy of Radiant Solar
as a copy of Radiant Solar

670-1619-3388-5400.easyPrerequisites:
You have a way to cause a creature to enter the battlefield under your control.
You are not currently venturing in a dungeon.
670-1619-3388-5400.description:
Put any nontoken creature onto the battlefield.
When the creature enters, Radiant Solar, Moritte of the Frost and Synth Infiltrator each trigger.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger, causing you to venture into Tomb of Annihilation and into the Trapped Entry room, causing each player to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Moritte of the Frost trigger, venturing into the Oubliette room, causing you to discard a card and then sacrifice Radiant Solar.
Resolve the Synth Infiltrator trigger, venturing into the Cradle of the Death God room, creating a 4/4 legendary The Atropal creature token and completing Tomb of Annihilation.
If you control two or more The Atropal tokens, put all but one into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Sefris' second ability triggers, returning Radiant Solar from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
670-1619-3388-5400.notes: If you are currently venturing in a dungeon when starting the combo, you can complete the dungeon and then use Sefris' second ability to put a creature onto the battlefield to start the combo.

413-4419--5.description:
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing the persist creature.
When the persist creature dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to Renata.
When the persist creature enters, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 1.
Repeat.

2034-7084-7201.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing another nonland creature you control.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the land.
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters, Sapling Nursery triggers, creating a creature token.
Repeat.

1409-5421-6441.description:
Activate Redcap Thief by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
When Redcap Thief enters, it and Deadeye Navigator's soulbond ability trigger
Resolve the Deadeye Navigator trigger, repairing it and Redcap Thief.
Resolve the Redcap Thief trigger, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate both Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{U}.
Repeat.

1479-2841-4862-6159.easyPrerequisites:
It is not your turn.
There is a land card in your library that can be fetched using Bloodstained Mire.
Your life total is at least 2.
1479-2841-4862-6159.description:
Fetch a land using Bloodstained Mire.
When the fetched land enters, Omnath and Kodama trigger.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Kodama and Omnath trigger.
Holding priority, activate Ghost Town's first abiltiy by tapping it, adding {C}.
Activate Ghost Town's second ability by paying {0}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Omnath from step 4, creating a token.
When the token enters, Kodama triggers, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Omnath triggers.
Repeat from step 5.

104-3490-4050-6752.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
104-3490-4050-6752.description:
Gain life.
Cleric Class triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters, Haliya triggers, causing you to gain life.
Cleric Class triggers. Holding priority, activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Servo, adding {1}.
Resolve the Cleric Class trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Repeat from step 3.

uses.n: The Legend of Kuruk // Avatar Kuruk

uses.battlefieldCardState: as a copy of Avatar Kuruk

3557-6913-7009.manaNeeded: {20} minus {1} for each creature and artifact you control each turn
3557-6913-7009.description:
Activate Chameleon using Avatar Kuruk's ability by paying {20} minus {1} for each creature and/or artifact you can tap while activating it, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Deal combat damage to an opponent using Brago. Brago triggers, blinking Chameleon. Choose to have it enter the battlefield as a copy of Avatar Kuruk.
Repeat each turn.

147-1532-2511.notablePrerequisites: You have a creature card in your graveyard.
147-1532-2511.description:
Cast Faith's Reward by paying its mana cost
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying its mana cost.
When Dualcaster Mage enters, it triggers, targeting Faith's Reward.
Holding priority, activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Dualcaster Mage.
Resolve the Dualcaster Mage trigger, copying Faith's Reward
Resolve the Faith's Reward copy, returning Dualcaster Mage from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

1017-3532-4985-5078.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Wizard Class triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
Repeat.

3525-6723-6936.description:
Activate Goblin Medics by tapping it, adding {U}.
Goblin Medics triggers, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Activate Pemmin's Aura by paying {U}, untapping Goblin Medics.
Repeat.

2653-4693-5721-6883.easyPrerequisites: There are at least six land cards between your graveyard and the battlefield under your control, one of which must be a Swamp.
2653-4693-5721-6883.description:
Activate Overgrown Estate by sacrificing any land, causing you to gain 3 life.
Repeat step 1 until you have at least six land cards in your graveyard, with one of those cards being a Swamp.
Activate Aftermath Analyst by paying {3}{G} and sacrificing it, returning all land cards from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the lands enter, Nissa triggers that many times, adding {B/G} for each trigger.
Activate Strands of Night by paying {B}{B} and 2 life and sacrificing a Swamp, returning Aftermath Analyst from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Aftermath Analyst enters, it triggers, causing you to mill three cards.
Repeat.

4222-6006-6858.description:
Activate Oreskos Sun Guide by tapping it, adding {U}.
Activate Freed from the Real by paying {U}, untapping Oreskos Sun Guide.
Oreskos Sun Guide triggers, causing you to gain 2 life.
Repeat.

4826-5720-5721-6620.notablePrerequisites:
There are at least four card types among cards in your graveyard.
Lands you control and/or land cards in your graveyard that enter the battlefield untapped can tap to produce at least {5}{G}{G}{G}.
4826-5720-5721-6620.description:
Activate Sylvan Safekeeper by sacrificing any land except Shifting Woodland.
Repeat step 1 until you control no other lands except Shifting Woodland.
Activate Shifting Woodland's second ability by paying {2}{G}{G}, causing it to become a copy of Aftermath Analyst until end of turn.
Activate Shifting Woodland by paying {3}{G} and sacrificing it, returning it and all other land cards from your graveyard to the battlefield untapped due to Archelos.
Activate any number of lands by tapping them, adding at least {5}{G}{G}{G}.
Repeat.
Resolve all Sylvan Safekeeper abilities.

2653-2893-3875-5455.notablePrerequisites: Fertilid has at least one +1/+1 counter on it.
2653-2893-3875-5455.description:
Activate Fertilid by paying {1}{G} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, searching your library for a basic land card and putting it onto the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters the battlefield, Bristly Bill, Nissa and Tireless Provisioner trigger.
Resolve the Bristly Bill trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on Fertilid.
Resolve the Nissa and Tireless Provisioner triggers, adding {G} and creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}. 
Repeat.

112-3490-4659-4871-5375.description:
Cast Clockspinning with buyback by paying {3}{U}, targeting Witch-Maw Nephilim.
Witch-Maw Nephilim's first ability triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing the Servo, adding {C}{C}.
When the Servo dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure artifact token.
Resolve Clockspinning, putting a +1/+1 counter on Witch-Maw Nephilim and returning Clockspinning to your hand.
Repeat steps 3 through 5 one additional time.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{U}.
Repeat.
You may also target any other creature you control that has a +1/+1 counter on it using Clockspinning.

711-3525-4289.notablePrerequisites:
Pemmin's Aura attached to Fallowsage.
Fallowsage does not have summoning sickness.
711-3525-4289.description:
Activate Fallowsage by tapping it, adding {U}.
Fallowsage triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Activate Pemmin's Aura's first ability by paying {U}, untapping it.
Repeat.

2495-3492-3609.notablePrerequisites: Coretapper does not have summoning sickness.
2495-3492-3609.description:
Activate Coretapper's first ability by tapping it, putting a charge counter on Magistrate's Scepter.
Activate Magistrate's Scepter's first ability by paying {4} and tapping it, putting a charge counter on it.
Activate Tezzeret's first loyalty ability by putting a loyalty counter on it, untapping Coretapper and Magistrate's Scepter.
Activate Coretapper's first ability by tapping it, putting a charge counter on Magistrate's Scepter.
Activate Magistrate's Scepter's second ability by tapping it and removing three charge counters from it, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

1392-2034-2557-4871.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional Goblin.
1392-2034-2557-4871.description:
Activate Weirding Shaman by paying {3}{B} and sacrificing a Goblin.
The Goblin dies, triggering Pitiless Plunderer, creating two Treasure tokens.
Resolve the Weirding Shaman ability, creating four 1/1 Goblin Rogue creature tokens.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing a Goblin Rogue creature token, adding {C}{C}.
The Goblin Rogue dies, triggering Pitiless Plunderer, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate two Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Repeat.

11-1357-4821.notablePrerequisites: Nonland permanents you control can tap to produce at least {2}{U}.
11-1357-4821.description:
Activate all mana producing nonland permanents you control by tapping them, adding at least {2}{U}.
Cast Dramatic Reversal by paying {1}{U}.
Holding priority, cast Narset's Reversal by paying {U}{U}, creating a copy of Dramatic Reversal and returning Dramatic Reversal to your hand.
Activate Errant by paying {1}{U} and tapping it, creating a copy of the Dramatic Reversal copy.
Resolve the first Dramatic Reversal copy, untapping all nonland permanents you control.
Activate all mana producing nonland permanents you control by tapping them, adding at least {2}{U}.
Repeat from step 4.

1308-1651-4231-4732-5261.notablePrerequisites: You control another artifact or creature.
1308-1651-4231-4732-5261.description:
Activate Isochron Scepter by paying {2} and tapping it to cast a copy of Deadly Dispute without paying its mana cost.
As an additional cost to cast Deadly Dispute, sacrifice a creature or artifact.
Resolve Deadly Dispute, drawing two cards and creating two Food tokens, two Clue tokens, and two Treasure tokens.
Activate the Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them to add {2}.
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping two untapped artifacts you control to untap Isochron Scepter.
Repeat.

1097-1636-3590.notablePrerequisites:
Malicious Intent attached to Warchanter Skald.
Warchanter Skald does not have summoning sickness.
1097-1636-3590.description:
Activate Warchanter Skald using the Malicious Intent ability by tapping it, targeting any creature.
Warchanter Skald triggers, creating a 2/1 Dwarf Berserker token.
Intruder Alarm triggers, untapping all creatures.
Repeat.

813-2104-2665.notablePrerequisites:
Enough mana available to cast the extra turn spell each turn.
Progenitor Mimic is a copy of Scholar of the Ages.
813-2104-2665.description:
Cast Temporal Manipulation by paying its mana cost, taking an extra turn after this one.
At the beginning of your next upkeep, Progenitor Mimic triggers, creating a token copy of Scholar of the Ages.
When the token Scholar of the Ages enters the battlefield, it triggers itself, returning Temporal Manipulation and up to one additional target instant or sorcery card from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.
